preconditions.description: The number of students and the number of clubs are within the specified bounds.
The potential of each student is within the specified bounds.
Each student is initially a member of a valid club.
The number of days for which the director wants to know the maximum possible strength of the team is within the specified bounds.
The student leaving their club on each day is within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly d lines, one for each day.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output_i <= 5000 for output_i in output)
postconditions.description: The strength of the team for each day is a non-negative integer, and does not exceed 5000.
